design_philosophy: A premium, safety-first family app. Calm, reassuring, and easy to use. Information-dense for admin but clean. Navy blue provides professional trust and stability, while yellow/amber adds warmth and high visibility for safety elements.

components.Card: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 p-5 shadow-sm
components.PrimaryButton: bg-[#FCB813] rounded-xl py-3.5 px-6 flex-row justify-center items-center shadow-sm active:bg-[#E5A40F]
components.SecondaryButton: bg-[#0F1B3D] rounded-xl py-3.5 px-6 flex-row justify-center items-center shadow-sm active:bg-[#1E3370]
components.OutlineButton: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#0F1B3D] rounded-xl py-3.5 px-6 flex-row justify-center items-center active:bg-slate-50
components.TextInput: w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-base text-[#0F1B3D]
components.TabBar: bg-white border-t border-slate-100 pb-safe pt-2 px-4 flex-row justify-around items-center h-20

auth.Login: Clean white background. Logo centered. Role selection buttons (Parent, Driver, Admin) with distinct icons. 'Sign In' primary button.

parent_app.Home: Header greeting 'Hello, Priya'. Top half features an embedded Map view showing live bus location. Bottom half features a draggable bottom sheet or stacked cards showing 'Aarav's Trip Status' (ETA, Driver Info, Status Timeline).
parent_app.Notifications: Vertical timeline layout. Entries for 'Bus Arrived', 'Child Checked-in', 'Handover Complete'. Green check icons for success, red X for alerts.
parent_app.Profile: Child profile cards with photo avatars. Settings, trip history, and subscription/payment management (Stripe).

driver_app.Home: Clean dashboard showing 'Today's Route: Route 3 - Morning'. List of stops in a timeline graphic. Prominent 'Start Route' primary button.
driver_app.ActiveRoute: Map view for navigation. Floating card showing next stop details. Large 'Scan Child' button anchored at the bottom.
driver_app.QRScanner: Full screen camera view with a scanning overlay. Success/Error modal overlay post-scan with child details.

admin_dashboard.Overview: Grid of stats cards: Total Routes (12), Total Students (156), Active Buses (8), On Time (92%). Scrollable alerts feed below (e.g., 'Bus 3 Delay').
admin_dashboard.LiveMap: Full screen map visualizing all active buses. Pinch to zoom. Tapping a bus shows a modal with driver, route, and occupancy details.
admin_dashboard.Management: List views for routes, drivers, and students. Use card-based layouts with status badges.

testing.guidelines: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing. Example: `data-testid="login-parent-button"`, `data-testid="start-route-button"`.

child_avatars.description: Young boy avatar, for student profiles (e.g., Aarav)
Young girl avatar, for student profiles

bus_icons.description: School buses, use for placeholder backgrounds or decorative elements in Admin app

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Expo React Native application using .js files. Do not use web DOM elements like div, span. Use View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity from react-native.
Style the components using NativeWind (Tailwind for React Native) referencing the Tailwind classes provided in the components section.
Implement a Bottom Tab Navigator for the main app structure for each role.
Use react-native-maps for the Map views.
Ensure the color palette accurately reflects the TripZen brand: Navy (#0F1B3D) and Yellow/Amber (#FCB813).
Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements for end-to-end testing.
Utilize the provided avatar URLs for placeholder student data.
